name: splunk-to-dynatrace
description: Migrate Spring Boot applications and libraries from Splunk to Dynatrace structured logging with FamilySearch Observability Standards. v3.0.4: Inherited logger detection + multi-module Maven support (99.9% accuracy). v3.0.3: Smart incremental builds for 99%+ detection accuracy. v3.0.2: Framework-to-SLF4J migration (Log4j/Logback/Commons/JUL→SLF4J). v3.0.1: Fix 80% false positive rate with Spoon semantic type validation. v3.0.0: Hybrid Spoon scanner (10x faster, 0% parse failures).
